title: Mobs & Mines V1
description: A Forgiving Vannila+ish Modpack for Neoforge!
body:
# **This Modpack is archived because I decided I don't like it. You can find a far better modpack [here](https://modrinth.com/project/vkhv3KsD) 💀**
## A forgiving Modpack for Explorers & Buiilders

Many self-acclaimed vanilla+ modpacks only add features that Mojang should've added already or they add far too many mods that alter the core gameplay mechanics too much.

Mobs & Mines is the place between the 2, it fills in Mojang's holes while still expanding the exploration and building aspects of the game in it's own special ways.

Subscribe to my YT! https://www.youtube.com/@Whisdan

### Mod List!

- Amplified Nether (Taller Nether)
- Appleskin (Makes Saturation Statistic Viewable)
- Archeological (Expands Archeology in a Vanilla+ fashion)
- Atmospheric (more biomes)
- Better Than Mending (Lets you mend anywhere)
- BetterF3 (Self Explanatory)
- Blueprint (Library)
- Chat Heads (See the heads of those blabbermouths)
- Chunks fade in (Self Explanatory)
- Clayworks (Adds Kiln and more Terracotta Blocks)
- Cloth Config API (Library)
- Collective (Library
- Creeper Overhaul (More Creepsters)
- Cristel Lib (Library)
- Dungeons & Taverns + Several Addons (More Structures!)
- Dynamic FPS (Lets you run MC in the backround easier)
- EMI (How the heck do I craft dat?)
- Enderman Overhaul (Self Explanatory)
- Enderscape (End Overhaul, Love A Newer Neoforge Port) 
- Environmental (Mooorrree Biomes)
- Essential Mod (Better Multiplayer)
- Explorify (More Structures)
- Feature Recycler (Appearently It Stops A World Gen Crash)
- Friends & Foes + addons (Adds Mob Vote Mobs)
- Fzzy Config (Configs)
- Galosphere (More Cave Biomes!)
- Geckolib (Library)
- Golem Overhaul (Morrrrreee Golems!)
- Iris Shaders (Required To Run Shaders)
- Jade + Addons (Tell Ye Watcha Lookin At!)
- Keep Some Modded Inventory (disable when playing keep inven)
- Kotlin for Forge (Library)
- Lithium (Performance)
- Lithostiched (Library, Worldgen)
- Lootr (enable for multiplayer)
- Luki's Strongholds (Much Better Strongholds)
- Miniature Shader (Shader)
- Mod Menu (Mod... Menu...)
- Moonlight Lib (Library)
- Motschen's Better Leaves (Bushy Leaves)
- Nature's Compass (So You Don't Spend 50 Hours Of Your Precious Life Looking For Biomes)
- Overweight Farming (Adds Big Crop Variants)
- Redstone Torch backport (Adds The Cool Looking Redstone)
- Resourceful Config (Config)
- Resourceful Lib (Library)
- Ribbits (Adds Frog Villages <3)
- Simple recall potion (Quick Return After An Adventure)
- Sodium (Head Honcho Performance)
- Stony Cliffs Are Cool (Gets Rid Of Ugly Dirt Cliffs)
- Subtle Effects (Adds, You Guessed It, Subtle Effects)
- Supplementaries (Adds Vannila+ Shtuff)
- Trimmed (Trims Compat)
- Upgrade Aquatic (Better Ocean, Beware The Thrasher)
- Village Spawn Point (I Spawned In The Middle Of A Godforsaken 1,000 Wide Desert, No More!)
- Visuality: Reforged (More Effect)
- YetAnotherConfigLib (Prob Another Config Library Mod)
- You've Goat to be Kidding Me! (More Goat Stuff)
- YUNG's API + addons (Structures)

 Have Fun!
